test_gtn_equal: test two gtn Graph objects for structural equality including nodes, arcs, labels, and weights
test_gtn_isomorphic: test whether two gtn Graph objects are isomorphic regardless of node ordering
test_gtn_loadtxt: test loading a gtn Graph from a text file with savetxt/loadtxt round-trip verification
test_gtn_savetxt: test saving a gtn Graph to a text file and verify output format matches expected lines
test_gtn_loadsave: test binary save and load of gtn Graph objects and verify equality after round-trip
